claims: WrestleMania 42 (2026) takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
WrestleMania 42 (2026) is available to stream exclusively on ESPN Unlimited in the U.S.
WrestleMania 42 (2026) is available to stream exclusively on Netflix in most international markets.
The two-night event starts at 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT at Allegiant Stadium.
The first hour of WrestleMania 42 (2026) is simulcast on ESPN2.
The first hour of both nights of WrestleMania 42 (2026) (6-7 p.m. ET) will air on ESPN2.
ESPN Unlimited app was formerly PPV/WWE Network.
WrestleMania 42 (2026) is available via FuboTV, DirecTV, Hulu+Live TV, or YouTube TV subscriptions that include ESPN.
Netflix streams WrestleMania 42 (2026) live in most regions outside the US.
Replays of WrestleMania 42 (2026) are available on the ESPN app shortly after the show.
The kickoff/pre-show for WrestleMania 42 (2026) starts at 3 p.m. ET/12 p.m. PT.
The main card for WrestleMania 42 (2026) starts at 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT.
ESPN Unlimited is available as a standalone service for $29.99/mo.
